newsitem.title: USA: United Water says UK tax to hurt Q3 earnings.
newsitem.headline: United Water says UK tax to hurt Q3 earnings.

text.p: United Water Resources said Thursday the new British windfall profits tax on privatized British utilities will hurt its third quarter earnings.

The company said the one-time tax will hurt its third quarter earnings from its investment in Northumbrian Water Group by about $0.35 per share. Northumbrian is an investor-owned water services company in Britain.
The company also said, however, that the tax will not hurt its corporate cash flow or its ability to pay dividends.

The company said the possible imposition of the tax had been factored into its financial analysis at the time of its investment in Northumbrian in June 1996, and was considered in determining the purchase price.
The one-time tax should not impact long-term benefits from its investment.
